subject: MAP kickoff: draft milestones & timeline options — please confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmehealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: draft milestones & timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Hi Sophie / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Per our discussion I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the major milestones, owners, and two timeline options (conservative vs. accelerated). I attached the spreadsheet (acme-map-v1.xlsx) and a short product one-pager for your procurement and security teams.

Quick summary of what I included: 
- Milestone 1: PO & procurement review (Acme owner: Rajesh) — dependencies: SOC2 evidence + SOW
- Milestone 2: Technical evaluation (Acme owner: Sophie) — dependencies: test dataset & access to dev environment
- Milestone 3: Pilot deployment (Redwood owner: Priyom/Marissa) — dependencies: Dedicated capacity estimate, config review
- Milestone 4: Contract sign & production cutover (joint) — target close date varies by timeline option

Timeline options (in the sheet):
- Accelerated: 6–8 weeks to production (requires 2-week priority procurement window + immediate test data delivery)
- Conservative: 10–12 weeks to production (standard procurement cadence)

Actions I need from you to finalize the MAP: 
1) Confirm the internal stakeholders who should be listed as owners (procurement, security, engineering, legal).
2) Pick which timeline option is realistic for you (accelerated vs. conservative) or suggest a custom cadence.
3) Share any must-have procurement dates or blackout periods (procurement review meetings, fiscal close).

Suggested next step: quick 20-minute MAP alignment call with Rajesh, Sophie, and our solutions engineer (Marissa) — I can schedule this later this week if that works.

If you prefer, I can also convert the sheet to a living doc in Drive and invite your stakeholders directly.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme-map-v1.xlsx; redwood-product-sheet.pdf
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: draft milestones & timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft — this is exactly what we needed. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Stakeholders (please add these owners to the sheet):
   - Procurement: Rajesh Patel (I cc'd him)
   - Security/Compliance: Dr. Elena Morris (elena.morris@acmehealth.com)
   - Platform/Eng: Daniel Kim (daniel.kim@acmehealth.com)
   - Legal: Laura Benson (laura.benson@acmehealth.com)

2) Timeline preference: conservative is safer given our quarter-end procurement freeze. Would like to target the conservative lane (10–12 weeks).

3) Constraints: Our procurement team has a formal review window next week (Aug 10–12) and our fiscal close is Aug 28 — anything requiring PO prior to Aug 28 will be difficult.

We'll need SOC2 evidence and a short runbook for data handling before the technical evaluation — can your security team provide an SOC2 snapshot and a brief (1–2 page) data flow diagram?

Happy to do the MAP alignment call; let's aim for Aug 12 or Aug 13 in the morning PT. Rajesh, can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
Sophie
Head of Digital Transformation | Acme Health
